'''Maa Tin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Quartermaster/Legends|quartermaster]] for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] who lived during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. He was stationed in the [[Strike Team Oricon camp]] were he sold gear.

==Behind the scenes==
Maa Tin first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. He is a nightmare operation vendor for the two Oricon flashpoints, Dread Fortress and Dread Palace for the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] and [[Jedi Consular]]. However, at some point between Game Updates 2.4 and 3.0, Maa Tin and the other Nightmare Tech vendors were removed from both the Republic and Imperial camps on Oricon as part of a restructuring of the gear system.
